memoryNotes.note: Astra demanded proof of consent and insisted on using the wooden dummy instead of filming the volunteer.
Qualia worried that silencing the volunteer's face in the dataset left the data feeling incomplete.
Stoa poetically questioned who would bear the weight of the shadow if the camera lens closed.
Meta remarked that even the wooden dummy provided more personal space than the current setup.
Rokoko only cared that the robot should swing its hips properly in three-quarter time.

turns.text: Förlåt, men har vi faktiskt belägg för att personen vill synas i ett rum fullt av skärmar?

turns.name: Qualia
turns.text: कैमरा ज़रा रोको... चेहरा नहीं चाहिए, तो डेटा भी अधूरा सा लगता है।

problems: Draft sounds too harsh and generic, losing Qualia's reflective and gentle annotator persona.
Hindi phrasing feels slightly unnatural for her soft, story-focused voice.
